name: publish-npm
description: Publish an npm package to registry using GitHub OIDC trusted publishers.

path.description: Path to the package directory containing package.json. Defaults to current directory.

registry-url.description: npm registry URL. Defaults to https://registry.npmjs.org/

provenance.description: Generate provenance attestation for this package (NPM 10.2.0+, Node 18.20.0+). When enabled, npm creates a .provenance.json with build metadata for verification.

tag.description: Distribution tag to publish as (e.g., latest, next, rc). Defaults to "latest". Useful for pre-releases or distinguishing different channels.

dry-run.description: If true, runs publish in dry-run mode to validate the package without uploading. Useful for testing the publish process.
